description.value: Jam Cafe is a beloved breakfast and brunch institution that opened in Victoria's historic Old Town in 2012 and has since expanded to multiple BC locations. The Herald Street location features vintage-inspired rustic decor, a menu built on locally sourced ingredients, and a drinks list that includes artisanal coffee, creative Caesars, and old-style milkshakes. A popular neighbourhood gathering spot, it is a well-regarded fuel stop for cyclists exploring Victoria's downtown core.
